paragraphs: GreenSight designs and builds robotic vehicles, offering both stock models and units made to order for a customer's specific mission. One line of that work is aimed at turf care.

Customers can buy an existing design outright and deploy it themselves, or commission a bespoke unit that the company designs and manufactures. The company positions its own work where robotics, analytics and automation overlap. It says its leadership comes from defense and technology backgrounds, and that this shapes rugged hardware and secure software.

The turf side is run by staff the company describes as career practitioners from the trade itself. Sales and service representatives are listed by region across the country. Alongside the commercial business it runs STEM education, internships and bootcamps for students.

quote.text: GreenSight develops and manufactures catalog and fully custom robotic vehicles to help our customers achieve their missions.
